versions.notes: System: bars for memory (RAM) and storage; the buttons are in small fold-out groups. Message texts: one card per message with bigger fields, tap to insert a placeholder, «standard text» and a preview.

picture for other programs (Home Assistant, Frigate, Blue Iris, VLC, NAS recorders): a secret address for the video (MJPEG) and a still picture, no login needed; optionally RTSP (H.264) if mediamtx is installed.

continuous recording (off by default): all the time with few pictures per second in 10-minute pieces, kept for N hours; the recordings page shows a 24-hour timeline with the alarms marked - tap to watch.

storage: the self-check shows where the program and the recordings are (SD card / SSD / USB); the recordings can be put on an SSD or USB drive (Settings -> Recording, existing ones are moved over); if the drive is missing at a start, the memory card is used and the self-check says so.

zones: «line» (a person crosses it - in both directions or only in the arrow direction) and «dwell area» (a person stays longer than N seconds); message in the log and - when armed - a push message with picture.
backup: the first picture of an alarm goes off the device at once (not only the clip at the end); clips too big for Telegram are made smaller instead of skipped; the self-check shows the backup.
operator mode button shows when it is on (since when) and ends it with the PIN; the header badge too.
«Recalibrate» and «Reset counter» removed from System («↻ Calibrate» stays next to the stick).

operator mode may change everything (also zones, schedules, waypoints, relays) - except what could lock you out: Wi-Fi / own Wi-Fi / network, web password, autostart, loading settings, «reset settings», update source. Unlocking with the PIN puts everything back.

operator mode keeps a copy of all settings when it is switched on; unlocking with the PIN puts back everything that was changed in the meantime (not: armed / disarmed, camera position, location, own Wi-Fi).

only one Motion Watch at a time: started by hand while the autostart runs it in the background (without a window), the program asks and takes over with its window (the background service starts again when the window is closed). The web page notices when a switched-off Pi is back and reloads by itself.

protection against crashes of the whole Pi: the AI runs at most a few times per second and slower when the Pi gets hot; every 10 s the program notes CPU temperature and power supply - after an unexpected end the self-check shows what it was like; two short runs in a row -> «safe start» (AI, thermal camera, night vision, IR light, patrol off) with a push message. The UPS shutdown needs plausible values and 3 minutes of running first.
the green arrows follow a switch at once (also in Simple), taken from the switches on the page itself.
AI model download from Google's storage address (the old address has no valid certificate); shorter error messages.
«download failed» message in all languages.
AI model with one tap: «Download AI model» (self-check, AI settings, Pi window) fetches the two model files (about 70 MB) into the data folder and switches the AI on - no commands needed any more.
one-page quick guide for the campsite (5 languages, printable): set up, connect, evening, alarm, morning, when something does not work. The QR card is now called «QR codes for connecting».

false alarms: mark a recording «was nothing» (animal, wind, light, rain, car, other); the recordings page then suggests matching settings (one tap to take them over) and can show only the false alarms.

settings «Simple / Expert» (simple: only the important ones, on the web and in the Pi window); button «Guard tonight»: switches on what a night needs, arms with the countdown and tells what is still missing.

self-check: one traffic light per part (camera, AI, servos, thermal camera, microphone, loudspeaker, temperature sensor, location, clock, internet, push, memory card, CPU temperature, power supply, battery, password, https) with what to do; on the web (panel + header badge) and in the Pi window (Weather & system).
